entries.prompt: Create one premium editorial raster illustration, landscape 1536 x 1024, for the inner Services pages of Guerrazzi, an Italian neighbourhood shop. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its very fine coloured-pencil / lithographic grain, beautiful tactile warm ivory paper, precise restrained cobalt ink, natural restrained side shadows, not its objects or composition. New composition: high oblique 3/4 view, a generic dark navy smartphone lying face up with blank opaque screen, two overlapping warm ivory document slips with only a few simple cobalt rules (no readable writing), one clean cobalt folded-paper tab. Tight elegant editorial still life, objects in the lower-middle/right with generous paper breathing room upper left, asymmetrical crop; no tabletop boundary or room. Distinct from the reference paper stack. Rich beautiful materials, refined not distressed, no dirty patches. No QR codes, barcodes, currency, bank cards, brands, logos, actual product packaging, human hands, tobacco, cigarettes, gambling, store interiors or UI screenshot. Must be a finished standalone artwork, not a website mockup. Not a factual document or photo of stocked products.

entries.prompt: Generate one premium editorial raster illustration in landscape 1536 x 1024 for a shop page about games and toys. New still life: sculptural generic wooden play shapes, one large matte cobalt arch partly cropped at right, natural pale beech cylinder on its side in foreground, small muted ochre sphere, and flat terracotta rectangular tile casting precise soft shadows. Low eye-level view with an elegant diagonal depth; plenty of ivory negative space. Materials should feel beautiful and believable, refined designer editorial illustration, clean bright Mediterranean warmth, tiny edge details, no distress. Four simple forms, no faces, no anthropomorphism, no horror, no creatures. No brands, words, numbers, retail packaging, actual recognizable toy model, people, children, tobacco or store interior.
